words.title: Server settings
words.pageLine: How deadwax runs, as your compose file or .env sets it. A change saved here takes effect at once, with no restart, and is used instead of what the file says until you revert it. Your own choices - what Get does, the quality floor, Format and whether cancelling asks first - are in Settings, under Getting albums.

words.retimeHint: Move the timings of lyrics already saved to the lead above. Only files that are still exactly LRCLIB's lyrics are touched.
words.retimePrompt: Lyrics saved before the lead changed keep their old timings until re-timed.

words.clearHint: Every saved answer gone, on disk and in memory. Only speed is lost: the next answers are asked of MusicBrainz again.
